items.title: Stall detector: a node.log line when a session exceeds its timeout fraction
items.brief: Watch each session's elapsed time against its job timeout; past 80% write one node.log line naming the subject and the fraction.
items.acceptance: `go test ./internal/node/ -run Stall` passes; node.log gets one `stall: <subject> <fraction>` line past 80% of the job's timeout; README's Observability section, docs/adr/017's Consequences and the TRD's §6b all describe the shape this item lands, in the same words.
items.model_reason: one detector with tests to copy, its docs folded in
